measurementRules.rule: Q is the sum of unique new first-quality-release net masses after conditioning, including body, woven backing and retained cured finish, excluding detachable core/packages. Retain actual gross/tare calibration, conditioning and cohort records under cp_release. Closing FG already released belongs in Q; it is not added again as another production output.

Measure net mass and finished usable width/length/profile on the same conditioned complete rolls or representative traceable samples. Derive mass/area from independent measurements; record actual thickness profile if a volume bridge is needed. Roll count or nominal catalogue thickness cannot supply kg. Never infer measured density or mass/area from a native secondary conversion.

Preserve original quantity units and independent state-specific conversion data before attribution. Convert measured kWh to MJ with 3.6 MJ/kWh only as an exact unit conversion. Integrate genuine rates once; an integrated gas/liquid volume is already a quantity. Density is measured for that substance at the stated composition, pressure and temperature, never borrowed from water.

measurementRules.required_property: Attributed raw numerator and reference mass
measurementRules.rule: Protocols collect unnormalised raw quantities. Convert units, reconcile stock/inherited vectors and determine attribution first. Section8 contains the sole A/Q (or service A/Qc) division; every card and protocol aggregation references that same result, not another division. Q=0 keeps real burdens/flows and pending attribution, without a unit result. H is an observed interval and is not a second divisor.

Use a whole wet supply/article mass OR a mutually exclusive constituent bridge on that same side of the same physical gate. Assay/active/solids/carrier water and coating layers are subaccounts, not additive purchases. X removes only an independently observed OTHER same-side duplicate already represented by another quantity there; real independent material/water/reaction interfaces remain explicit and are never fitted or subtracted as X.

calculationRules.rule: Convert raw records to each actual native quantity before attribution. For a rate integrate over measured time once; for an integrated volume retain that volume. Use independent substance/state density for mass conversion and real inlet/return enthalpy for heat. No native non-reference meanValue creates a measured factory property.

For an unused raw-stock balance, use actual opening plus receipts plus external returns received minus actual closing minus unused external returns sent to derive issues, unless already net measured. For each exchange vector, combine real assigned new activity with inherited opening WIP minus inherited closing WIP and measured transfers at the same gate; do not subtract stock again from a net numerator. Separate dedicated/virtual subdivisions, exchange-specific causality and justified residual allocation to produce A. Losses, failure, idle, cleanup and Q=0 remain assigned or explicitly pending.

a = A / Q for manufacture; a_service = A_service / Qc for the original released cohort over observed H. This is the sole division after conversion, stock-vector reconciliation and attribution. Cards and collection aggregation display this result directly. For Q or Qc zero, retain the real raw/attributed ledger with no unit result. Q excludes packaging and repeat release; closing first-released FG is already in Q.

p = V_native / Q for manufacture or V_native / Qc for original-cohort services, using real gross physical movement, separately from A-based burden results. Do not multiply by a stock-value/economic allocation share, subtract returns from gross shipments, or divide observed H again. This physical view is not added to the burden view.

A_roll is independently measured usable width-length/profile area; m_roll is independently weighed conditioned net complete-roll mass. Derive mass_per_area = m_roll / A_roll only for the matched construction/sample. For a volume bridge integrate measured thickness over the actual same profile and measure matched mass/state independently. No catalogue size, recipe density or native secondary factor is a measurement.

At each manufacturing, FG and consolidated gate, total actual opening stock plus gross external inputs equals actual closing stock plus gross external outputs; cancel paired internal handoffs only in the consolidated view. Whole wet articles OR mutually exclusive measured constituents form the mass bridge. X removes only observed OTHER same-side duplication, never an independent flow, real chemical increment, stock or opposite-side event. Run independent relevant-element balances and separate molecule/water/oxygen/biogenic-carbon ledgers with actual reaction/speciation evidence. Never fit two unknowns from one residual or treat evaporation as reaction/repair. Unknown closure remains inconclusive.

For each original cohort independently close the complete actual wet FG ledger: opening FG + actual new first-release transfers + actual external returns + actual rework returns + real independent non-water additions + water uptake = closing FG + gross physical dispatch + actual discard/destructive tests + actual rework issues + real independent non-water removals + water loss. Keep every leg mutually exclusive and on its actual wet state; material already inside a whole receipt/exit/stock is nested, never another addition/removal. Record real additional matter as specific atomic exchanges; do not fit a water/material residual. A new first-release transfer is the actual physical handoff linked to its unique acceptance event and origin-basis bridge, not the denominator Q0 added again. An old cohort with opening already accepted FG has no new release merely because it is observed, dried, returned or dispatched; current-period new manufacture may be zero while original Qc=Q0,c remains positive. Keep paired transfer states and actual later transformations independently; all original acceptance-basis fates reconcile separately under v_ext_cohort_acceptance. Reinspection/authorization makes no new Q. Carry each historical vector once through real transfers and any justified original-delivery reversal, and add only actual incremental service/rework. Full physical movements remain distinct from attributed A; observed services use original Qc and H is never a divisor.

For each actual packaging material pool use the literal wet physical equation F_open + P + I + ER_in + J_in + H2O_in + C_in + O_in - X_in = F_close + S_gross + EO_out + W_whole + J_out + H2O_out + C_out + O_out - X_out. F_open/F_close include all empty, WIP-attached, FG-attached and reusable wet stocks. P is actual new separate purchased package supply, I actual packaging arriving with supplied materials, ER_in actual external returns received, S_gross the entire package physically accompanying every gross shipment including repeat shipments, EO_out actual external returns sent, and W_whole the whole exported waste. These transfer masses include their measured retained contents once. J_in/out are real independently crossing non-water additions/removals not already inside those whole legs; H2O_in/out are separately observed water exchanges not already included there. C_in/out preserve any real matched conversion/transfer between defined pool classes, cancelled only in the consolidated boundary; they are never invented mass creation. Moisture/adhesive/ink/retained product already contained in a weighed package is a nested component, not another J or water input. X may remove only a specifically observed OTHER same-side quantity already represented elsewhere on that same side; identify the overlap and both underlying records. X cannot subtract named independent P/I/ER/S/EO/W/J/water/C events, stock/opposite-side quantities, real chemical increments or an amount merely because a card exists. No residual is fitted. This replaces the historical use of X as an unidentified real OTHER flow: a real new material requires its own identified atomic interface, not X. O_in/out are sums of individually identified observed OTHER interfaces, each with its actual atomic card and raw record; they are not unidentified baskets or fitted balancing flows. Only a documented overlapping part of an O term can be X, linked to its already represented same-side record; every nonoverlapping O part remains a real physical flow.

For one real commingled linoleum consignment choose measured W OR disjoint measured originW whose sum reconciles W; W is then a control total, not another additive waste. Keep one treatment provider and correct waste/product status; internal reuse is a separate matched handoff. Species/assay indicators are subledgers, not extra physical waste.

collectionProtocols.collection_method: For actual infrared-active vapor-phase aldehydes and other identified target gases, Method320 and its complete FTIR Protocol provide a real procedure, not merely a method title. Water/CO2 overlap, adsorption, reaction and unintended condensation must be checked. Use Method320 pre-test QA spikes and the full 12-spiked/12-unspiked validation branch with bias/precision evaluation where required; recondition/retest or reject failing data. A condenser/dilution is permitted only with the actual through-train recovery and sample-conditioning validation, or a valid parallel conditioned/unconditioned comparison; do not discard captured analyte and still claim original whole-gas concentration. The Protocol and all appendices in the complete 50-page original remain part of this method. Actual spectra, calibration and matrix tests are study qualification, not evidence that no analytical programme exists. No site is asserted already qualified.

collectionProtocols.collection_method: Actual stack-flow/PM work must include the complete Methods1–3 and5 dependencies: suitable actual traverse geometry and cyclonic/small-duct exclusions; calibrated pitot/meter and measured temperature/pressure, gas composition and moisture; leak checks, nozzle/isokinetic conditions, blanks, complete front-half/filter recovery, gravimetry and actual dry-standard-volume calculations. Method5 measures its defined heated-filterable particulate fraction; it is not a molecular assay or proof for wet mist/condensable aerosol or all PM sizes. Method3's restricted dry-molecular-weight calculation and residual N2+CO fraction do not establish pure N2 or Ar; its assumed gas weight is not a measured factory value. No generic VOC/PM/COD indicator or one residual is assigned to a molecule. If actual droplets, wet aerosol or condensables matter and an applicable complete collection/phase/analysis procedure is not established, preserve that specific essential hold rather than claim total-PM closure.

collectionProtocols.raw_fields: original inlet/final outlet sample ID and phase; native/background; probe/container/loop; actual T/P/collection/storage time; conditioning and separate water receiver; gas volume/flow/dilution; certified Ar/O2/N2 component concentrations spanning samples; multipoint calibration/raw areas/regression; baseline separation/interference; blank/carryover; duplicates; direct/full-path/before-after conditioning/holding paired recoveries; independent introduced Ar amount; uncertainty and failure decision; original cohort
collectionProtocols.collection_method: Do not use FTIR for homonuclear N2/O2 or monatomic Ar. For the actual carrier-air inlet/outlet account, the following is an independent combined GC-TCD measurement programme, not a claim of a published Ar stack validation or regulatory Method3C conformity. First define actual final outlet, inlet/background, wet/dry measurand, target gas range, phases and uncertainty objectives; the EPDs do not establish additional Ar generation or a fixed air composition. (1) Use the complete Method3 inert probe, representative sample, purge, leak-checked constant-flow collection and sealed identified gas-container procedure. Record actual T/P, flow/volume and elapsed collection/storage; choose inert materials that do not remove the target gases. Preserve simultaneous unconditioned and conditioned sample provenance; document every condenser/filter/dryer and actual separated receiver mass. (2) Use actual GC-TCD columns with measured Ar/O2 separation under the real sample matrix. The Agilent2022 Molsieve/backflush configuration is a demonstrated separation starting point, not a default setting or proof at every loading. Verify actual Ar and O2 standards separately and together with N2/CO2/H2O and every real interferant; dilute only with measured certified gas and preserved mole-amount basis, never atmospheric ratios. (3) Extend Method3C's explicit per-compound calibration framework to Ar: traceable certified Ar standards at at least three actual concentrations bracketing the final measured range, matrix/zero blanks, calibrated loop/sample T/P and identical gas-state basis, component-specific response regression, triplicate check standard and duplicate sample injections. Apply the source Method3C calibration-verification/recalibration and duplicate-agreement conditions to the declared composite programme; label that choice as author synthesis, not a reported Ar result. Retain standard certificates, slopes/intercepts, residuals, range, spectra/chromatograms and uncertainty. (4) Challenge the complete actual probe/transport/conditioning path with a traceable known Ar addition upstream and matched no-addition samples, and compare a direct standard bypass with the same standard through the full path. Perform separate before/after-conditioning comparisons on the same original-gas basis; account for measured added gas, collection pressure/temperature, water removal and actual dilution. Net Ar recovery is the difference in reconstructed downstream Ar mole amounts between matched spiked and unspiked runs divided by independently introduced Ar moles; use the measured native background and actual time/flow, not a single concentration subtraction at unequal flow. Retain blank/container carryover, repeated path recoveries and holding-time paired samples; never copy the note's single-standard LOD or recoveries for other gases. (5) Before testing fix the uncertainty-based acceptance plan, full-path/background controls and repeatability/calibration checks. Reject or repair/retest when Ar/O2 cannot be resolved, the actual range is uncalibrated, blanks/carryover invalidate identity, drift/duplicates fail the adopted Method3C conditions, or unexplained loss/enrichment exceeds the declared combined uncertainty. No generic recovery percentage is invented. (6) Only accepted data provide separately measured dry/wet mole fractions and measured total gas amount/flow on the same state basis; convert each molecule using its own molar mass and actual state/dilution, reconcile inlet/pass-through separately from generated/consumed species. This gives a specified procedure and failure path. Its independent scientific applicability and actual site QA remain separate; absence of actual execution alone does not mean there is no programme. If an actual necessary original-phase capture or conditioning branch cannot be specified or fails these tests, hold that dependent result, preserve all real physical air legs and unknowns, and do not claim Ar closure or remove the source by paper outsourcing.

collectionProtocols.raw_fields: consignment ID; entire wet physical Qt; receiver measured quantity; nested dry tare and retained powder/liquor/water; actual receiver and provider reference unit; transport; actual own/provider complete treatment; original and old cohort Q0; disjoint service demands and inherited A vectors; unassigned residual; no double provider feed
collectionProtocols.collection_method: For each actual receiver consignment t record full physical wet Qt independently of any allocation or original cohort. It includes the entire contaminated substrate/cartridge/cloth/package and its retained dust, liquor and water once; dry tare and retained constituents are nested assays unless physically separated before that gate. Keep its measured receipt, actual receiver, transport and complete treatment boundary/reference unit. One whole mixed Qt OR mutually exclusive origin masses reconciled to Qt feeds the physical provider once. Independently assign nonoverlapping treatment-service/burden demands to all real original cohorts, old cohorts and non-product causes, retaining their original Q0,c and inherited A_e vectors; undistributed demand stays explicit. A 10 kg consignment with a 25% cohort burden share remains 10 kg physical transfer, not 2.5 kg, and is not charged 10 kg again to each cohort. If the provider reference is volume, item or treatment service, establish actual composition/state or service conversion; do not assume kg-provider compatibility. Include own treatment inputs, controls and outputs once, or the complete external treatment inventory once; never provider-embedded history plus the same decomposed treatment again.

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Check whole native object: every basename/synonym/comment, CAS, route/grade/form/state, geography, type/media and all properties. Preserve reference-property and unit-group chains and supplier compatibility. Generic family identity does not establish a specific supplier, formulation or measurement. Contradictions cannot be waived by a matching CPC/name.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Native identity chain; supplier specification; restriction disclosure in every consuming card

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Retain complete primary context, figures, composition tables and variant footnotes. The two industrial sources are different producers/editions; no source number or EPD result is a factory default. Actual site data and independent chemistry/measurement support all quantitative results.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Full source and figure context; actual owner/recipe/measurement records

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Reconcile unused raw, actual nonWIP, WIP and released FG separately, with every inherited exchange vector and real failed/zero-output/idle/rework/treatment event. Unknowns and coverage gaps remain explicit; do not assert a passing balance or zero emission from missing data.

Disclose calibration, sample coverage, detection limits, blanks, temporal/site representativeness, stock-vector provenance, allocation sensitivity and unresolved identity/provider support. Ordinary auxiliary/provider gaps do not redefine the complete linoleum method; missing core finished-product/route/endpoint support blocks applicability.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Measurement reports; provenance; uncertainty and separate gap ledger

measurementRules.rule: Q为调湿后唯一新增首次质量放行净质量之和，含主体、机织背衬及保留固化涂层，排除可拆芯筒/包装。cp_release保留真实毛/皮重校准、调湿及批次记录。已放行期末FG已在Q中，不再加为另一生产输出。
在同一调湿完整卷材或可追溯代表样上测净质量及成品有效幅宽/长度/轮廓。由独立测量得到质量/面积；需体积桥接时记录真实厚度轮廓。卷数或目录标称厚度不能提供kg。不得从原生次级换算推导实测密度或质量/面积。
归属前保留原数量单位及独立同态换算数据。实测kWh按3.6 MJ/kWh精确单位换算。真实速率只积分一次；已积分气/液体积已是数量。密度须为该物质在声明组成、压力及温度下实测，绝不借水密度。

measurementRules.required_property: 归属原分子及参考质量
measurementRules.rule: 协议采集未归一化原数量。先换单位、核对库存/继承向量并定归属。第8节执行唯一A/Q（服务A/Qc）除法；各卡片及协议汇总引用同一结果，不再除一次。Q=0保留真实负荷/流及待定归属，不出单位结果。H为已观察期间，不是第二个除数。
在同一物理门同侧使用整份湿供货/制品质量，或互斥组分桥接。检测/活性/固体/载水及涂层为子账，不是加和采购。X仅消除该侧另一数量已表征的独立实测OTHER重复；真实材料/水/反应接口另列，不拟合或作X扣除。

calculationRules.rule: 归属前将原记录换至各真实原生数量。速率按实测时间积分一次；积分体积保留体积。质量换算使用独立物质/状态密度，热使用真实进/返回焓。不用原生非参考meanValue创造工厂实测属性。
未用原料账按真实期初加接收加外部返回收到减真实期末减未用对外退还推领用；已净实测则不再扣。各交换向量在同门合并真实归属新活动、继承期初WIP减继承期末WIP及实测交接；净分子不再扣库存。专属/虚拟细分、逐交换因果及有证剩余分配分开得到A。损失、失败、闲置、清理及Q=0仍归属或明确待定。
制造a = A / Q；已观察H内原放行批服务a_service = A_service / Qc。这是换单位、库存向量核对和归属后的唯一除法。卡片和采集汇总直接展示该结果。Q或Qc为零时保留真实原/归属账，不出单位结果。Q排除包装及重复放行；期末首次放行FG已在Q内。
制造p = V_native / Q，原批服务V_native / Qc，使用真实实物总移动，与A负荷结果分开。不乘库存估值/经济分配份额，不从总发运扣返回，不再除已观察H。此实物视图不加到负荷视图。
A_roll是独立测定有效幅宽长度/轮廓面积；m_roll是独立称得调湿完整卷材净质量。仅对匹配构造/样本取mass_per_area = m_roll / A_roll。体积桥接按真实同轮廓实测厚度积分，并独立测匹配质量/状态。目录尺寸、配方密度或原生次级因子不是测量。
各制造、FG及合并门：真实期初库存加外部总输入等于真实期末库存加外部总输出；仅合并视图抵消配对内部交接。整湿件或互斥实测组分构成质量桥。X仅消除实测OTHER同侧重复，绝不扣独立流/化学增量、库存或对侧事件。独立作相关元素平衡及分子/水/氧/生物碳账，须真实反应/物种证据。不以一残差拟合两未知，不把蒸发作反应/修复。未知闭合仍为不能判定。

逐原批独立闭合完整实际湿基成品账：期初成品+真实新增首次放行交入+真实外部退回+真实返工交回+独立真实非水新增+吸水=期末成品+毛实物发运+真实报废/破坏试验+真实返工交出+独立真实非水移除+失水。全部腿互斥并按实际湿状态；整份接收/出口/库存内已含物质只作嵌套，不能再作增减。真实额外物料按具体原子交换记录，不拟合水或物料残差。新增首次放行交入是真实物理交接，并链接唯一验收事件及来源基准桥，不把分母Q0再加一次。期初已有验收成品的旧批，不因观察、干燥、退回或发运而新增放行；当前期间新增制造可为零，原Qc=Q0,c仍保持正值。成对交接状态及真实后续转化独立保留，全部原验收基准去向另按v_ext_cohort_acceptance核对。复验/授权不新建Q。历史向量沿真实转移及有理由的原交付冲回仅一次，只增加真实增量服务/返工。完整实物与归属A分开；实际服务按原Qc，H不作除数。

各真实包装材料池使用字面全湿实物式：F_open + P + I + ER_in + J_in + H2O_in + C_in + O_in - X_in = F_close + S_gross + EO_out + W_whole + J_out + H2O_out + C_out + O_out - X_out。F_open/F_close含全部空置、附WIP、附FG及可复用湿库存。P为独立新购包装，I为随原料到货包装，ER_in为收到外部返回，S_gross为每次实物总发运（含重复发运）随带整包装，EO_out为实际对外退还，W_whole为整件外送废物；各腿所称质量已含其真实滞留物一次。J_in/out为尚未计入这些整腿、真实独立跨池的非水增减；H2O_in/out为尚未包含的独立实测水交换。C_in/out保留池类之间真实成对变换/交接，仅合并边界可抵消，绝不创造质量。已在整件称量中的水/胶/墨/滞留产品仅为嵌套组分，不再作J或水投入。X只可消除该侧另一有明确实测记录、已被该侧其他量表征的OTHER重复项，须指认重叠及两原记录；不能扣除有名独立P/I/ER/S/EO/W/J/水/C事件、库存/对侧量、真实化学增量或仅因卡片存在而扣量，不拟合残差。历史将X作为未识别真实OTHER流的做法由此替换：真实新增材料须有独立有名原子接口，不能藏在X。 O_in/out仅为逐项具名实测OTHER接口之和，各项有真实原子卡及原记录，不是未识别集合或拟合平账流。只有O项内有证重叠部分才可作X，并关联已表征同侧原记录；互不重叠O部分仍是真实实物流。
一种真实混收油毡废物交运采用实测W，或互斥实测originW且合计核对W；此时W为校核总量，不是另一加和废物。唯一处理方及正确废物/产品状态；内部复用为另匹配交接。物种/检测指标是子账，不是额外实物废物。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 对实际红外活性气相醛及其他已识别目标气体，Method320及完整FTIR Protocol给出真实程序而非标准名：建立目标/干扰物参考谱（缺失时按Protocol4.6制备）、仪器分辨率/光程/温压与谱区、背景/CTS校核、RMS噪声/MAU/分析不确定性，使用加热惰性探针/管线/气室并真实排除颗粒，记录泄漏、响应时间及原始干涉图。核对水/CO2谱重叠、吸附、反应及意外冷凝。采用Method320测试前QA加标，以及需要时完整12加标/12未加标、偏倚/精密度评估的验证支路；失败须修复重测或拒绝数据。冷凝/稀释仅在全程回收和样品调理验证、或有效平行调理/未调理对照成立时适用；不能弃去捕集分析物后仍称原整气浓度。完整50页原件中的Protocol及全部附录是本方法组成。真实谱/校准/基质测试属研究资格，并非分析程序不存在；不声称现场已合格。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 真实烟气流量/PM工作须包含完整Methods1–3及5依赖：实际适宜遍历几何及旋流/小管道排除，已校准皮托管/表及实测温压/组成/水分，泄漏、喷嘴/等速条件、空白、完整前半段/滤件回收、重量法和真实干标体积计算。Method5测其规定的加热可过滤颗粒分数，不是分子检测，也不证明湿雾/可凝结气溶胶或全部粒径PM。整捕集颗粒与另有证材料/物种表征分开；主体配方不是排尘组成。Method3有限干分子量及剩余N2+CO分数不确立纯N2或Ar，假设气重不是工厂实测。VOC/PM/COD或一个残差不能指派给分子。实际液滴、湿气溶胶/可凝物重要而完整捕集/相态/分析程序尚未建立时，保留具体必要hold，不能宣称总PM闭合。

collectionProtocols.raw_fields: 原进/最终口样品ID/相; 原气/背景; 探针/容器/环; 实测温压/采存时间; 调理及分收水; 气量/流量/稀释; 浓度包围样品的认证Ar/O2/N2标准; 多点校准/原面积/回归; 基线分离/干扰; 空白/残留; 重复; 直接/全程/调理前后/保持成对回收; 独立加Ar量; 不确定性/失败判定; 原批
collectionProtocols.collection_method: 同核N2/O2和单原子Ar不用FTIR定量。对真实载气空气进/出口，以下为独立组合GC-TCD程序，不冒称已发表Ar烟道验证或符合Method3C法规。先声明真实最终口/进气背景、干湿检测量、浓度范围/相态及不确定性目标；EPD不证明额外生成Ar或固定空气组成。(1)用完整Method3惰性探针、代表采样、吹扫、检漏恒流收集及密封标识气体容器程序，记录实测温压/流量/气量及采存时长，选择不移除目标气体的材料。保留调理前后原样来源、每冷凝/过滤/干燥步骤及分收接收质量。(2)在真实基质上用GC-TCD柱实测Ar/O2分离。Agilent2022分子筛/回吹配置仅为已证明分离的起点，不是默认设置或所有负载的证明；分别及合并用Ar/O2标准，并带N2/CO2/H2O及真实干扰物检验。稀释仅用实测认证气量与摩尔量基，不用大气比例。(3)将Method3C逐组分校准框架明确扩展至Ar：至少三个真实浓度、覆盖最终测量范围的可追溯认证Ar标准，基质/零空白，已校准环/样品温压及相同气态基准，逐组分响应回归、三次校核标准及样品双进样；对本组合程序采用Method3C原校准验证/重校准及重复一致性条件，标注作者综合而非已有Ar结果。留证书、斜率/截距、残差/范围、色谱及不确定性。(4)在真实探针/传输/调理全程上游加入独立已知可追溯Ar，并取匹配未加标样；比较直接旁路标准与同标准全程通过。调理前后均回到同一原气基，计实测加气、收集温压、水移除与稀释。净Ar回收=匹配加标/未加标下游重建Ar摩尔量之差/独立加入Ar摩尔量，使用实测原背景和真实时间/流量，不在不同流量时只减浓度。保留空白/容器残留、重复全程回收和保持时间成对样，不搬用单标准LOD或其他气体回收。(5)测试前固定基于不确定性的接受计划、全程/背景控制及重复/校准校核；Ar/O2未分离、实际范围未校准、空白/残留损害身份、漂移/重复不符所采用Method3C条件，或未解释损失/富集超过声明合成不确定性时，拒绝或修复重测，不造通用回收百分比。(6)仅合格数据给同态独立实测干/湿摩尔分数及总气量/流量，再按各物种摩尔质量与真实状态/稀释换算，进气/穿透与反应生成/消耗分开。以上是具体程序及失败路径，独立科学适用性与实际现场QA另审；未执行本身不是程序不存在。真实必要原相捕集/调理支路无法具体建立或未通过时，仅hold依赖结果，保留全部真实空气腿/未知，不称Ar闭合或纸面外包删除生产者。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 逐真实接收交运t独立于分配/原批记录全实物湿Qt，含整件污染基材/滤芯/布/包装及滞留粉、液、水一次；除非门前真实分离，干皮重与滞留组分只是嵌套检测。保留实测接收、真实接收方、运输和完整处理边界/参考单位。整混Qt或互斥来源质量且合计核对Qt，仅一次输入实物供方；另将互不重叠的处理服务/负荷需求分给各真实原批、旧批及非产品原因，保留原Q0,c和继承A_e向量，未分配需求明确留存。10 kg交运即使某批负荷占25%，实物仍为10 kg而非2.5 kg，也不向每批重收10 kg。供方参考为体积/件/服务时须有实测组成状态或服务换算，不能默认kg供方。自有处理的投入/控制/产出一次，或完整外部处理清单一次；不得供方嵌入历史与同一分解处理再加。
